g.text: Legend (SysML v2 general view): sharp box = definition, rounded box = usage,
dashed = reference usage; «keyword» and <short name> above the name; lists
inside a box = compartments. Hollow triangle = specialization (points to the
general type); filled diamond = composite feature; hollow diamond with open
arrow = reference feature, held by the diamond end and labelled with the link
type and multiplicity. A box with a need ID links to its page.
